title: City Of Syracuse to Close Offices in Observance of Columbus Day
summary: City of Syracuse will close administrative offices on Monday, October 12, 2026 in observance of Columbus Day. Trash and recycling collection will continue on regular schedule; Department of Public Works yard waste drop-off will be closed; metered parking will be free; emergency services and Cityline app requests remain available.
